author: Seung Wook
problem: Read a string S of English letters. Print Yes if it contains at least one uppercase letter, at least one lowercase letter, and no letter appears twice; otherwise print No.
bug_description: Compares the set of characters itself to len(S) instead of len(set(S)), which is never equal, so the program always prints No.

comments.accurate: Checks that S has both upper- and lowercase letters and all its characters are distinct
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks S for mixed case and compares its set of characters directly against len(S) to reject repeated letters
comments.wrong_location: Distinctness test verified; check the case tests for strings with no letters of one case

source.buggy_line: if S.upper()!=S and S.lower()!=S and set(list(S))==len(S):
source.fixed_line: if S.upper()!=S and S.lower()!=S and len(set(list(S)))==len(S):
